cohort: The study included 355 postpartum mothers (89 cases and 266 controls) who gave birth at hospitals in the South Gondar Zone, Northwest Ethiopia.
finding: New-onset postpartum preeclampsia was significantly associated with advanced maternal age (>= 40 years), fewer than four ANC visits, contraceptive use, irregular physical activity or inactivity, a history of multiple gestations, and gestational diabetes mellitus.
